turns.q: Is a damaged item handled differently from a normal return?
Do you need photos, and where do I send them?
turns.replyTail:
Yes, please send clear photos showing the damage, along with a short description of the issue and your order number, through Tediber’s delivery help page.

Please submit the claim within 72 hours of delivery. If you have not already done so, record the damage on the carrier’s delivery document as well.

turns.q: Will I get a replacement or a refund?
turns.replyTail: I can’t promise a replacement or refund before the damage has been reviewed. Please send the clear photos, a short description of the issue, and your order number through Tediber’s delivery help page. The appropriate solution will depend on the product and the damage confirmed.

turns.q: Do I have to pay anything to return the damaged item?
turns.replyTail: A damaged item is handled differently from a change-of-mind return, so the change-of-mind return fee schedule does not apply. The return arrangements depend on the country the item would be sent from. Which country would you return it from?

turns.q: How long does the replacement take?
turns.replyTail:
I can’t give you a confirmed replacement timeframe before the damage has been reviewed. Please send the photos, a description of the issue, and your order number through Tediber’s delivery help page.

If a warranty replacement is approved, the return of the damaged product and delivery of the new product take place during the same appointment slot proposed by customer service.

turns.q: What if more than one item in my order is affected?
turns.replyTail:
Please report every affected item in the same delivery claim. For each one, include a clear description and photos showing the damage, along with your order number, through Tediber’s delivery help page.

Submit the claim within 72 hours of delivery and record all the damage on the carrier’s delivery document if you have not already done so.

turns.q: Can I keep the damaged item or must I ship it back?
Will the replacement ship with priority?
turns.replyTail: A priority shipment is not guaranteed for a replacement. The damage must first be reviewed and the replacement approved. If it is approved, the damaged product is collected and the new one is delivered during the same appointment slot proposed by customer service.

turns.q: What if the replacement is also damaged?
turns.replyTail:
If the replacement arrives damaged, report it promptly as a new damage claim. Send clear photos or a video, a description of the damage, and your order number through Tediber’s delivery help page.

The issue will be reviewed again. Depending on the confirmed damage, Tediber may arrange a repair, replacement part, or replacement product. A replacement or refund is not automatic. Please submit the claim within 72 hours of delivery and note the damage on the carrier’s delivery document if possible.
